purpose: B14-U2 bounded SECURITY DEFINER authoring capability that creates one self-scoped Activity with optional Life Area assignment and canonical description, location and per-item color metadata in the same transaction.

routine.return_type: TABLE(activity_ref uuid, title text, created_at timestamp with time zone, life_area_ref uuid, assignment_revision bigint, description text, location text, color_code text, replayed boolean)

state_history.current_binding: The capability returns the canonical Activity descriptor plus optional accepted Life Area assignment. Schedule remains a separate capability and identity family.
state_history.chronology: Activity creation and optional organization/descriptor metadata are accepted in one authoritative PostgreSQL transaction.
state_history.immutability_policy: Same operation id and intent replays the accepted result; changed intent for the same operation id is rejected. Generic runtime descriptor UPDATE remains denied.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: The accepted B14-U2 authoring contract is evolved only through reviewed forward migrations.

obligations: function owner is dante_owner and SECURITY DEFINER is enabled
runtime receives bounded EXECUTE but no generic descriptor write authority
Life Area assignment is optional and no synthetic default area is created
description, location and item color are canonicalized inside the authoritative create transaction
same operation/same intent replays while conflicting reuse is rejected
